_comment: /deploy-global merges this block into ~/.claude/settings.json idempotently (additive upsert by command — see deploy-global step 13). SessionStart with no matcher; the script filters to startup|clear|compact. On a fresh context it joins two self-gating sections (flow protocol in a flow workspace, git-hygiene facts in any git repo); on compact it emits the condensed process map instead and clears flow-context's per-session markers so portable planning state re-emits. Silent when nothing applies. Advisory only — never blocks.
